Accelerating payments to keep construction projects on track.

Jake Bruton, Owner of Aarow Building, is widely recognized not just for his custom home builds and remodels in Columbia, MO, and the Kansas City area, but also for his educational videos on building science and construction best practices on social media.

While Jake always has the latest insights on building techniques and materials, until recently, his business was still relying on antiquated paper checks to get paid. This often led to delays that disrupted the entire construction supply chain and sometimes even put projects on hold.

With Truss, Jake found a faster, simpler way to send and receive payments online. By switching to Truss, Office Manager Pamela now saves valuable hours each week, ensuring vendors are paid on time and projects stay on track.

With Truss, Jake can collect payments from anywhere, without having to chase clients for payment or wasting time driving to pick up checks. His clients appreciate how easy it is to pay invoices with a few clicks.

Paper checks didn’t just cause payment and project delays—they also added hours of tedious admin work every week, and forced Pamela to make unnecessary trips to the bank to deposit checks that exceeded transfer limits.

Truss has allowed Pamela to be more efficient in her day-to-day by integrating payments with their accounting software. Now, invoices and bills are automatically synced with Truss, making reconciliation effortless and freeing up Pamela’s time to focus on other priorities.
New look, new style, new name – same great product.

Daylight Concepts brings natural daylight into homes with tubular skylights and patented technology. As the exclusive Solatube Premier Dealer in the greater Tampa Bay area, the company is committed to providing incomparable quality, price, and service.
René is a part of the team in charge of payments and admin for Daylight Concepts. He aims to provide customers with a seamless and secure payment experience while streamlining his own workflow.
Previously, customers who wanted to pay by credit card had to disclose their payment information over the phone. This raised security concerns for both clients and the company.
“Most of our clients prefer to pay via credit card.”

With a background in finance and retail, René knows all too well the high merchant fees associated with credit card payments. Previously, Daylight Concepts allowed clients to pay via card using Quickbooks Payments, resulting in significant percentage-based fees that added to the company's cost of goods sold.

As for many businesses in the construction industry, checks are still a reality, causing many headaches for René and his colleagues in the field. Checks have to be collected by the installers at the customer’s house, then physically brought into the office. It can take over two weeks for René to receive and deposit a check, unless it gets lost in the mail, further delaying the process.
New look, new style, new name – same great product.
“Checks ruin a productive schedule.”

, located in Seattle, WA, is a premier residential remodelling contractor specializing in the Design Build Model. This approach offers clients a seamless experience by handling all aspects of a construction project from ideation to construction.

CEO Craig is directly involved from the very beginning of a project, selling to the customer and designing concepts. Craig’s productive schedule would often get ruined by having to pick up and drop off checks for payments. With Truss, he found a full-circle payment solution, reclaiming valuable hours every week.

Truss saves him the hassle of driving around and going to the bank. Silver Peak’s clients and vendors appreciate the fast and simple payment checkout process. Payments can be sent via email or text and accepted in a few clicks - anywhere, anytime.
WHITE-GLOVE ONBOARDING

Not only was setting up their account straightforward and quick, thanks to the immediate support from the Truss team, but Truss also remained available and helpful, answering any questions the Silver Peak team had after onboarding.

Truss not only streamlines Craig's workflow but also simplifies tasks for his bookkeeper, Hannah. With Truss's seamless integration with QuickBooks Online, bills and invoices are automatically imported, streamlining the process.

Hannah can prepare draft payments in Truss, allowing Craig to effortlessly approve and dispatch payments. Upon completion, Truss automatically updates transactions as paid, removing the need for further reconciliation steps.
New look, new style, new name – same great product.
